author: Animan
description:
These dark fantasy anime prove that humans can be far more terrifying than monsters. From brutal warlords and corrupt rulers to betrayal, revenge, paranoia, and horrifying secrets, these are 10 anime where humanity becomes the real threat.

Some of these anime are dark fantasy masterpieces you may already know. Others are hidden gems that deserve far more attention. But they all share one thing: the scariest monster isn't always the creature standing in front of you.

In this video, we're covering 10 dark fantasy anime where humans are the REAL monsters, including Now and Then, Here and There, Basilisk, Übel Blatt, Wolf's Rain, The Beast Player Erin, Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers, The Summer Hikaru Died, Kemonozume, Le Chevalier D'Eon, and Ragna Crimson.

If you love dark anime, psychological anime, underrated anime, disturbing anime, fantasy anime, anime recommendations, and stories with morally complex characters, this list is for you.
